programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Drishyam
programme.desc: When the disappearance of a policewoman's son threatens to ruin Vijay's family, he leaves no stone unturned in order to shield his family.

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lover's outrage.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Agnivarsha
programme.desc: In a kingdom stricken with drought, two rival priests, Yavakri and Parvasu, try to appease the rain god, Indra. However, their efforts result in adultery, treachery and bloodshed.

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine
programme.desc: After Gopika and Kishan get married, she learns that her husband is a widower and has a child. She leaves him but later returns, asking him to accept her son from a previous relationship.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Market Raja MBBS
programme.desc: While in the pursuit of Raja, a ruthless don, the police accidentally kill Chandrababu, a medical student. Things take a turn when Chandrababu's spirit possesses Raja and turns him into a gentle soul.

programme.title: Kaise Kahoon Ke...Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: Karan, a burglar, wishes to permanently leave his profession when he falls in love with Priya. They decide to get married, but Karan finds out that he has cancer.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Krantiveer
programme.desc: After being disowned by his family, Pratap, a juvenile gambler, ends up in Mumbai where he gets adopted by Laxminath, a landlord. However, when Laxminath is murdered, Pratap vows to avenge him.

programme.title: Action Time
programme.desc: Vedha and his daughter Kanaka are on a killing spree. They are being chased by a cop Rama, but they always manage to escape in the nick of time. Can Rama stop the killings.

programme.title: Khakee: The Real Police
programme.desc: When a drug lord ransoms police officer Diwakar's son for a bag of cocaine, he has no choice but to steal it from police headquarters. However, this raises the suspicions of his colleague Mallika.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?
programme.desc: Asha, a rich man's daughter, is arrested for her uncle's murder. Inspector Anand, who loves her, tries his best to solve the case and save her.

programme.title: Strange Evidence
programme.desc: S2 E8 — The Omen of Blood RiverCameras capture mysterious red lights shooting into the sky above the Alps, prompting scientists to try to recreate the phenomenon with an experiment. A pack of dogs rips a car apart, leaving experts searching for some possible motive.

programme.title: Discovered by Disaster
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Timeless Tombs and Modern SurvivorsA Bronze Age village, a Notre Dame fire and a 19th-century grave reveal ancient lifestyles. Tar pits showcase extinct mammals and shed light on prehistoric climate change.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: S4 E2 — Victoria and Albert's Highland FlingTony Robinson visits the Cairngorms National Park to discover how Queen Victoria and Prince Albert helped shape Scottish traditions and imagery, such as tartan, bagpipes and caber-tossing. Starting in Pitlochry, he traverses the Killiecrankie Pass, where the Jacobites won the Battle of Killiecrankie, and ends his trek at Balmoral and the fantasy castle Albert built as his and Victoria's Highland escape.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: S4 E3 — Norman Conquest of PembrokeshireTony Robinson heads to the south-west corner of Wales and one of Britain's finest coastal paths to find out why Pembrokeshire feels so English, even though it's more than 100 miles from the border. With its numerous castles and a fine cathedral, there are sure signs the Normans stamped their mark over the area. Tony's four-day walk traces the story of their conquest of the county, which he discovers was very different from the knockout victory at Hastings, involving a long, fiercely fought struggle.

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: S9 E21 — OswestryDavid Dickinson travels to Oswestry, Shropshire, to value antiques. Dealer David Ford has mixed feelings about a set of Irish passports, a Toby jug and a leather bullion bag, while Brenda Haller values a Hornby train set.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: S17 E14 — First Lady of PawnRick grapples over a decision when a WWE Hall of Fame ring hits the store.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: S17 E22 — Pawn of LibertyAn original Beach Boys surfboard, a magazine feature penned by Mark Twain, an early spirit hydrometer and an original Peter Max painting of the Statue of Liberty are assessed.

programme.desc: S14 E8 — The Shadow PeopleMillions of people around the world have reported encountering shadowy entities who instil fear, shortness of breath, and even paralysis. This programme contemplates whether it is possible that the so-called 'Shadow People' are more than mere figments of the imagination.

programme.title: Secrets in the Dark

This episode focuses the 'fairy coffins' - 17 miniature coffins containing carved figures, discovered in 1836 on Arthur's Seat, Edinburgh, with their exact purpose remaining a mystery. Plus, how the 1717 wreck of Black Sam Bellamy's pirate ship Whydah Gally yielded treasure, skeletons and new insights into the hidden world of piracy from its watery grave off Massachusetts.

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed with Danny Trejo
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Chamber of SecretsFrom priceless treasure found inside a lost city, to an ancient manuscript hidden behind a wall, Danny explores mysterious secrets lost deep inside various unseen chambers, including tunnels, caves and burial sites.

programme.desc: S1 E9 — Eruptions and EnigmasThe unexpected things revealed by catastrophic disasters - both natural and human made - can reveal in their wake. Sporting comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Vince Vaughn and Christine Taylor.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Chihuahua
programme.desc: A pampered pet dog gets separated from her owner, and is left stranded in Mexico struggling to avoid a dognapper and a ferocious Doberman, who are after her diamond collar. Luckily, a courageous German shepherd is on hand to help her get back home. Comedy, starring Piper Perabo and Jamie Lee Curtis, with the voices of Drew Barrymore and Andy Garcia.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Hannah Montana: The Movie
programme.desc: As her pop starlet alter-ego Hannah Montana's fame begins to grow, teenager Miley Stewart gets carried away with the success and is sent to work on the family farm in Tennessee. With help from her faithful friends, she begins to discover who she really is and what is important in life. Family comedy, starring real-life father and daughter Miley and Billy Ray Cyrus, alongside Emily Osment, Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: The Good Dinosaur
programme.desc: In a world where the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs never happened, humans have evolved as a primitive species while the giant lizards remain the dominant life form on Earth. A young apatosaurus becomes separated from his family, but finds a friend in a feral human boy as he makes the dangerous journey home. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Raymond Ochoa and Jack Bright.

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: A street urchin is caught up in a scheming grand vizier's plot to get his clutches on a magical lamp. Retrieving the object from a wondrous cave, he releases a powerful genie trapped inside, whose ability to grant wishes helps the young hero thwart the villain's plans and woo a princess. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Robin Williams, Scott Weinger and Linda Larkin.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: The Princess Diaries
programme.desc: An ordinary teenager discovers she is descended from royal stock and her grandmother is a queen. However, when this formidable regal lady insists she learn to behave like a princess, life suddenly becomes very complicated. Family comedy, starring Anne Hathaway, Julie Andrews, Heather Matarazzo and Hector Elizondo.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: The struggling owner of a run-down gym is forced to take drastic action to prevent an arrogant fitness guru buying the business out from under him - and enlists his customers to form a dodgeball team in the hope of triumphing in the US championships. Sporting comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Vince Vaughn and Christine Taylor.

programme.title: Juno
programme.desc: A teenage girl finds herself pregnant after a one-night stand with her best friend. Deciding to give her baby up for adoption, she thinks she has found the perfect parents in a yuppie couple. However, over the next nine months she begins to experience doubts about her plans. Comedy, starring Elliot Page, Michael Cera, Jennifer Garner and Jason Bateman.

programme.title: Flightplan
programme.desc: A widow boards a plane with her daughter and promptly falls asleep. When she wakes up, the girl has disappeared - and the mother's fear turns to outright panic when the aircraft crew insists she boarded the flight alone, suggesting the child is merely a figment of her distressed imagination. Thriller, starring Jodie Foster, Peter Sarsgaard, Sean Bean and Greta Scacchi.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in wintry 1961 New York to visit his idol, Woody Guthrie, in self-imposed convalescence at Greystone Park Psychiatric Hospital. An impromptu acoustic performance of a song that Bob has written for Woody propels his star into the ascendancy. Oscar-nominated biopic, starring Timothee Chalamet.

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: A fairy falls in love with an ambitious human nobleman, who betrays her in pursuit of claiming the throne. She swears to get revenge on him by placing a curse on his daughter, only to find herself developing a maternal bond with the girl. Fantasy adventure based on the story of Sleeping Beauty, starring Angelina Jolie, Elle Fanning, Sharlto Copley and Imelda Staunton.

programme.title: The Tigger Movie
programme.desc: Tigger realises being the only one of his kind makes for a lonely life, so he sets off on a bold quest to find more creatures just like him, with the help of his woodland friends. Animated adventure, with the voices of Jim Cummings, Nikita Hopkins, Ken Sansom, John Fiedler, Tom Attenborough and Peter Cullen.

programme.title: Cars 2
programme.desc: Racing car Lightning McQueen heads overseas to compete in an international grand prix, with events in Britain, Japan and Italy. He gets mixed up in international espionage when a case of mistaken identity leads to an encounter with two English spy cars searching for a powerful gadget. Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: Clownfish Nemo becomes separated from his friends on the Great Barrier Reef - but the thrill of being able to swim freely and away from his overprotective father turns to horror when he is netted by a diver. His distraught dad sets out on a mission to find him, while the youngster finds himself in a dentist's tropical tank. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: The modern-day teenage son of the Greek god Poseidon must lead his friends on a perilous journey into the Bermuda triangle. They need to recover the legendary Golden Fleece to save the world, but getting to it means braving all manner of terrifying monsters. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

programme.title: A Goofy Movie
programme.desc: The Disney cartoon dog takes his son on an old-fashioned fishing trip in an attempt to bond with the lad. However, young Max has boasted to his pals that he is going to a pop concert in Los Angeles, and has a few ideas on how to trick his dopey dad. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Bill Farmer, Jason Marsden and Wallace Shawn.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: Wall-e
programme.desc: A waste-collecting robot becomes humanity's last hope when it finds a sustainable plant living amongst the ruins. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ben Burtt, Elissa Knight, Jeff Garlin, Fred Willard and John Ratzenberger.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget
programme.desc: A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
programme.desc: Amid emerging demand for hyperfuel and other resources, a headstrong pilot gets mixed up with a bunch of mercenaries, a militant robot, a gambler and a Wookie while attempting to appease a crime lord in an adventure that exposes an underworld's seedy belly. Sci-fi prequel set before the events of Star Wars: A New Hope, starring Alden Ehrenreich, Emilia Clarke, Woody Harrelson, Donald Glover and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: Nightbitch
programme.desc: A nameless stay-at-home Mother tends to her young son in the suburbs while Husband casually goes out to work. Trapped in a whirlpool of rage and frustration about the loss of her identity, Mother becomes convinced that she is turning into one of the dogs that roam the neighbourhood. Dark comedy adapted from Rachel Yoder's novel, starring Amy Adams and Scoot McNairy.

programme.title: The East
programme.desc: A former FBI agent working for a private security firm is sent to infiltrate an anarchist movement behind a series of actions against corrupt corporations. She joins them in their acts of sabotage, but finds her loyalties changing as she forms connections with members of the group. Thriller, starring Brit Marling, Elliot Page and Alexander Skarsgard.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: A repressed ballet dancer leads a sheltered life, devoted entirely to her art. She pursues the lead role in a production of Swan Lake, but the director convinces her she will only be capable of dancing the part if she embraces her darker impulses. This leads her into a destructive relationship with a rival that threatens her sanity. Drama, starring an Oscar-winning Natalie Portman. With Mila Kunis, Vincent Cassel and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: The Tigger Movie
programme.desc: Tigger realises being the only one of his kind makes for a lonely life, so he sets off on a bold quest to find more creatures just like him, with the help of his woodland friends. Animated adventure, with the voices of Jim Cummings, Nikita Hopkins, Ken Sansom, John Fiedler, Tom Attenborough and Peter Cullen.

programme.title: Piglet's Big Movie
programme.desc: The plucky porker is upset when his friends tell him he is too small to come honey-harvesting with them, so he embarks on an adventure of his own - and it is not long before his pals start to miss him and realise just how important he is. Animation, featuring the voices of John Fiedler, Jim Cummings and Andre Stojka.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: Well-meaning ant Flick lands his colony in trouble when he accidentally disposes of an offering meant for a swarm of greedy grasshoppers - who promptly promise a horrible revenge. Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: First Semi-FinalCoverage of the first semi-final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at Dallas Stadium in the USA. Some of the greatest matches in World Cup history have taken place at this stage of the tournament, including a 1958 encounter between Brazil and France, when a 17-year-old Pele scored a 23-minute hat-trick in a 5-2 victory, while 1970 saw Italy triumph 4-3 over West Germany in Mexico, with five of the seven goals scored in extra time in a game many will remember for Franz Beckenbauer playing with his arm in a makeshift sling after dislocating his shoulder. The West Germans avenged that loss 12 years later with a penalty shootout victory in Spain in one of the most controversial matches in history, which saw West German goalkeeper Harald Schumacher deliberately collide with French player Patrick Battiston, knocking him unconscious and forcing him from the game with two missing teeth and three cracked ribs. Schumacher didn't even receive a yellow card and kept goal for the remainder of the match, which his side won on penalties after a thrilling 3-3 draw, in what was the first-ever World Cup finals match to be decided by spot kicks.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: First Semi-FinalCoverage of the first semi-final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at Dallas Stadium in the USA. Some of the greatest matches in World Cup history have taken place at this stage of the tournament, including a 1958 encounter between Brazil and France, when a 17-year-old Pele scored a 23-minute hat-trick in a 5-2 victory, while 1970 saw Italy triumph 4-3 over West Germany in Mexico, with five of the seven goals scored in extra time in a game many will remember for Franz Beckenbauer playing with his arm in a makeshift sling after dislocating his shoulder. The West Germans avenged that loss 12 years later with a penalty shootout victory in Spain in one of the most controversial matches in history, which saw West German goalkeeper Harald Schumacher deliberately collide with French player Patrick Battiston, knocking him unconscious and forcing him from the game with two missing teeth and three cracked ribs. Schumacher didn't even receive a yellow card and kept goal for the remainder of the match, which his side won on penalties after a thrilling 3-3 draw, in what was the first-ever World Cup finals match to be decided by spot kicks.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: First Semi-FinalCoverage of the first semi-final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at Dallas Stadium in the USA. Some of the greatest matches in World Cup history have taken place at this stage of the tournament, including a 1958 encounter between Brazil and France, when a 17-year-old Pele scored a 23-minute hat-trick in a 5-2 victory, while 1970 saw Italy triumph 4-3 over West Germany in Mexico, with five of the seven goals scored in extra time in a game many will remember for Franz Beckenbauer playing with his arm in a makeshift sling after dislocating his shoulder. The West Germans avenged that loss 12 years later with a penalty shootout victory in Spain in one of the most controversial matches in history, which saw West German goalkeeper Harald Schumacher deliberately collide with French player Patrick Battiston, knocking him unconscious and forcing him from the game with two missing teeth and three cracked ribs. Schumacher didn't even receive a yellow card and kept goal for the remainder of the match, which his side won on penalties after a thrilling 3-3 draw, in what was the first-ever World Cup finals match to be decided by spot kicks.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: First Semi-FinalCoverage of the first semi-final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at Dallas Stadium in the USA. Some of the greatest matches in World Cup history have taken place at this stage of the tournament, including a 1958 encounter between Brazil and France, when a 17-year-old Pele scored a 23-minute hat-trick in a 5-2 victory, while 1970 saw Italy triumph 4-3 over West Germany in Mexico, with five of the seven goals scored in extra time in a game many will remember for Franz Beckenbauer playing with his arm in a makeshift sling after dislocating his shoulder. The West Germans avenged that loss 12 years later with a penalty shootout victory in Spain in one of the most controversial matches in history, which saw West German goalkeeper Harald Schumacher deliberately collide with French player Patrick Battiston, knocking him unconscious and forcing him from the game with two missing teeth and three cracked ribs. Schumacher didn't even receive a yellow card and kept goal for the remainder of the match, which his side won on penalties after a thrilling 3-3 draw, in what was the first-ever World Cup finals match to be decided by spot kicks.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: First Semi-FinalCoverage of the first semi-final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at Dallas Stadium in the USA. Some of the greatest matches in World Cup history have taken place at this stage of the tournament, including a 1958 encounter between Brazil and France, when a 17-year-old Pele scored a 23-minute hat-trick in a 5-2 victory, while 1970 saw Italy triumph 4-3 over West Germany in Mexico, with five of the seven goals scored in extra time in a game many will remember for Franz Beckenbauer playing with his arm in a makeshift sling after dislocating his shoulder. The West Germans avenged that loss 12 years later with a penalty shootout victory in Spain in one of the most controversial matches in history, which saw West German goalkeeper Harald Schumacher deliberately collide with French player Patrick Battiston, knocking him unconscious and forcing him from the game with two missing teeth and three cracked ribs. Schumacher didn't even receive a yellow card and kept goal for the remainder of the match, which his side won on penalties after a thrilling 3-3 draw, in what was the first-ever World Cup finals match to be decided by spot kicks.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: First Semi-FinalCoverage of the first semi-final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at Dallas Stadium in the USA. Some of the greatest matches in World Cup history have taken place at this stage of the tournament, including a 1958 encounter between Brazil and France, when a 17-year-old Pele scored a 23-minute hat-trick in a 5-2 victory, while 1970 saw Italy triumph 4-3 over West Germany in Mexico, with five of the seven goals scored in extra time in a game many will remember for Franz Beckenbauer playing with his arm in a makeshift sling after dislocating his shoulder. The West Germans avenged that loss 12 years later with a penalty shootout victory in Spain in one of the most controversial matches in history, which saw West German goalkeeper Harald Schumacher deliberately collide with French player Patrick Battiston, knocking him unconscious and forcing him from the game with two missing teeth and three cracked ribs. Schumacher didn't even receive a yellow card and kept goal for the remainder of the match, which his side won on penalties after a thrilling 3-3 draw, in what was the first-ever World Cup finals match to be decided by spot kicks.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: First Semi-FinalCoverage of the first semi-final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at Dallas Stadium in the USA. Some of the greatest matches in World Cup history have taken place at this stage of the tournament, including a 1958 encounter between Brazil and France, when a 17-year-old Pele scored a 23-minute hat-trick in a 5-2 victory, while 1970 saw Italy triumph 4-3 over West Germany in Mexico, with five of the seven goals scored in extra time in a game many will remember for Franz Beckenbauer playing with his arm in a makeshift sling after dislocating his shoulder. The West Germans avenged that loss 12 years later with a penalty shootout victory in Spain in one of the most controversial matches in history, which saw West German goalkeeper Harald Schumacher deliberately collide with French player Patrick Battiston, knocking him unconscious and forcing him from the game with two missing teeth and three cracked ribs. Schumacher didn't even receive a yellow card and kept goal for the remainder of the match, which his side won on penalties after a thrilling 3-3 draw, in what was the first-ever World Cup finals match to be decided by spot kicks.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E1Mussolini joins Hitler in his fight against the Allies, while Winston Churchill is appointed British Prime Minister on the day of the Blitzkrieg, the German invasion of France.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E2Germany continues to build its empire in Europe, occupying Poland, Czechoslovakia, Austria, Luxembourg, Norway, Denmark, The Netherlands and Belgium. France is conquered and divided as Churchill rejects any attempt at an armistice.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E4After Pearl Harbour and their triumphant sweep across South-East Asia, Japanese armies celebrate their victory. But Japanese confidence is shaken four months later at the Battle of the Coral Sea.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E6From the Indian border in Burma to China, which has been at war with Japan since 1937, the war grows more savage. In Europe, despite having less resources than when he first made the attempt, Hitler renews his assault on the Soviet Union.

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.desc: E2A Liberator bomber from RAF Transport Command takes off from Gibraltar for England. On board is General Władysław Sikorski, Prime Minister of Poland's London-based government in exile and Commander-in-Chief of its armed forces.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Bomb
programme.desc: E2Did Nazi uranium make it to Japan in the final months of WW2? Were the Axis powers closer to a bomb than we think? Drama unfolds as experts shed new light on the hardships, challenges and secrets of a war-torn, pre-nuclear world.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The definitive, if not the best, Axis fighter of World War two: we delve into the story of legendary ace Adolf Galland and examine in detail and example of the type in his colours. We also look at the technical heritage the 109 designers left.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E5The Soviet Union produced a large variety of tanks and airplanes during World War II. What made the T34 and the Chaika stand out and become icons?

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E6Two of the fastest combat aircraft of World War 2, their origins couldn't differ more. The Messerschmitt 262 was the brainchild of genius designer Willy Messerschmitt and it became the first combat jet in history.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The Junkers Ju 52, which is considered one of the most famous airplanes in history. It was first designed as an airliner, but was used as a transport, bomber, and air ambulance during the Second World War.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Grumman Avenger, which was the most important carrier-based torpedo bomber on American and British carriers throughout the Second World War. They were also the biggest and heaviest carrier aircraft of the conflict.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Bomb
programme.desc: E1Did Nazi uranium make it to Japan in the final months of WW2? Were the Axis powers closer to a bomb than we think? Drama unfolds as experts shed new light on the hardships, challenges and secrets of a war-torn, pre-nuclear world.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Bomb
programme.desc: E2Did Nazi uranium make it to Japan in the final months of WW2? Were the Axis powers closer to a bomb than we think? Drama unfolds as experts shed new light on the hardships, challenges and secrets of a war-torn, pre-nuclear world.

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.desc: E1February, 1943, a B-25 Mitchell Bomber crashes into Sharp Top Mountain. It was the third training crash in the area that night. What really caused this accident?

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.desc: E2A Liberator bomber from RAF Transport Command takes off from Gibraltar for England. On board is General Władysław Sikorski, Prime Minister of Poland's London-based government in exile and Commander-in-Chief of its armed forces.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Heinkel He 111 is one of the most recognised German aircraft of WW2. The broad winged design was a guinea pig for future bombers, with more variants than any other military aircraft of the time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6We trace the astonishing story of designers turning away from metal and back to wood to create a twin-engine bomber that could outrun almost any aircraft in the sky, yet deliver a bomb load greater than an Avro Lancaster.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7The Battle of Leyte Gulf tells the story of the largest sea conflict in history involving Pearl Harbor warships and the largest battleships in the world, and how the US Navy, despite kamikaze attacks and a Japanese decoy fleet, were victorious.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8In this episode we look at vessels built for amphibious combat. We begin by looking at the last reaming Landing Craft Tank (LCT) to serve on D-Day – LCT 7074. These huge landing craft were essential in delivering tanks, trucks, soldiers and supplies.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: E1It took only six weeks for the Nazi Army to conquer France, with an onslaught of tanks, aircraft and German troops. Witness the extraordinary military success of the Blitzkrieg campaign, through rare footage and firsthand accounts.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: E2On June 22, 1941, Germany launched Operation Barbarossa, a savage and merciless attack on the Soviet Union. Now, newly colorised film and amateur home movies provide an unprecedented inside look at this brutal conflict.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E1On September 1, 1939, Germany’s invasion of Poland throws the world into war. No longer a European affair, the conflict spreads: in the Pacific, Japan—at war with China since 1937—accelerates its imperial ambitions.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E2In the East, Hitler launches Operation Barbarossa and invades the Soviet Union, reaching the outskirts of Moscow. But winter and Soviet resistance break his momentum. The Red Army, boosted by relentless propaganda, put up a fierce fight.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The story of the prolonged development and the initially troubled operational history of the Boeing B-29 Superfortress. Forever known as the airframe that dropped the first atomic weapons on Japan, the B-29 lived on well beyond its war years.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E7True predators of the skies, the F-16 and the MiG-29 were created to fight each other, based on radically different design philosophies.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E8The Leopard 2 is probably the best all-around Main Battle Tank today, combining great mobility, a superior gun and excellent protection.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The Yakovlev Yak-3, a Second World War Soviet fighter that was regarded for its performance at low altitudes and its agility. It was one of the most successful Soviet aircraft designs of the war.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The Republic P-47 Thunderbolt, a Second World War fighter aircraft produced by the American company Republic Aviation from 1941 until 1945. It was considered a successful high-altitude fighter and also served as the foremost US fighter-bomber in the ground-attack role.

programme.title: Guns That Changed The Game
programme.desc: E1Small arms production hit a boom in the early 1800s with the emergence of the modern cartridge; an invention that led to the lethal package.

programme.title: Guns That Changed The Game
programme.desc: E2While the single shot rifle remained a mainstay until WWI, machine guns had been in development since the final days of the American Civil War.

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.desc: E3For the men about to board "Miss Every Morning Fixin", the pressures of the War had been eased by a period of rest and relaxation in Queensland, but they were returning to war operations in Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea. They were never to return.

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.desc: E4In the early hours of 8th July 1944, a normally quiet part of rural Northamptonshire was a hive of activity as the 17 twinned engine Wellington bombers rumbled down the runway of their Turweston airfield home.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The F15 Eagle immediately turned the tide of the first Gulf War to prove its greatness. Our immaculately restored MiG Killer was involved in one of the most bizarre combat incidents during that conflict, and has survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The mighty Flying Fortress takes to the air as we examine the background and development of one of WWIIs most iconic bombers. Serving with both the USAAF and the RAF, we see it in action and fly a surfing example.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E1Nazi Germany boasted that its locomotives were faster and more innovative. This programme examines that claim by looking at these ‘flying trains’.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E2Veterans and historians of the Thai-Burma railway tell the story of its construction. Built to supply Japan’s invasion of India, it cost thousands of lives – both POWs and Asian slave labourers.

programme.title: Guns That Changed The Game
programme.desc: E3The industrial revolution changed it all when it came to cannons as they evolved from wholly inaccurate and immobile to deadly killing machines.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E3In 1914, Russian designer Nikolay Lebedenko decided to engineer a solution to the problem of trench warfare with an armoured vehicle with huge wheels that could move over any terrain.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E4Discover the true story of a German Luftwaffe pilot in World War II who risked his own life to save the crew of an American B-17 bomber.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: E11By early 1945, the end was in sight. After months of hard fighting the Allies were advancing towards the Rhine and to the east the Russians were closing in on Berlin as part of Operation Bagration.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
